why: In each row every part appears in exactly two of the three cells. Row 3: the up arrow is in both cell 1 and cell 2, so it must not appear in cell 3. The left and right arrow heads and the two diagonal heads each appear only once, so cell 3 needs a double horizontal arrow and a double diagonal arrow. That is option 3.
